page.title: Ads
page.description: Moderation, ads, advertisers and the rate card.

moderation.noCreatives: No banners added — check before approving.

reject.title: Reject ad
reject.notice: The reason is sent to the client over Telegram — write it for them, not as an internal note.
reject.label: Reason
reject.placeholder: e.g. banner text does not meet store policy

pause.title: Pause ad
pause.confirm: The ad will be taken off air temporarily — impressions will stop. You can resume it any time.
pause.timeWarning: The run doesn't stop: paused days aren't given back and the ad still ends on {date}. Impressions not delivered during the pause are lost.

resume.title: Resume ad
resume.confirm: The ad will go back on air and impressions will continue. Do you really want to resume it?

finish.title: Finish ad
finish.confirm: The ad will be finished and cannot go live again. Continue?

creatives.title: Title
creatives.activeHint: Turn off to temporarily stop showing this banner.
creatives.removeConfirm: The banner will be deleted. Continue?
creatives.imageTooSmall: Image too small: at least {min} px required (uploaded {actual}).
creatives.cardOnlySlot: This placement shows text banners only — no image upload.
creatives.hrefInvalid: The link must start with https://.
creatives.slotRequired: Select a placement for the poster.
creatives.lockedHint: Banners can only be changed before moderation. A live banner can still be switched off.
creatives.noImageSlots: This ad has no poster placements — text banner only.
creatives.cardSlotHint: A text banner shows in every placement of the ad.

deactivate.title: Take this banner off air?
deactivate.text: Your ad will stop showing in «{slot}». You can turn it back on any time.
deactivate.time: The campaign keeps running and ends on {date} — impressions while the banner is off are lost.
deactivate.last: This is your last active banner — your ad won't show anywhere.

stats.hint: Impression — rendered; viewed — on screen for over a second.

orders.readOnly: The client pays from their portal — admins cannot create payments.

advertisers.noTelegram: No Telegram linked — approval/rejection messages will not arrive.
advertisers.autoActivate: No manual approval needed — the account activates automatically once its first ad is approved.
advertisers.blockConfirm: A blocked account cannot sign in to the portal. Continue?
advertisers.notePlaceholder: Internal note — not shown to the client

rateCard.lead: MangaBox shows {count} ads a day. Pick the place that suits you.
rateCard.legend: The purple block is where your ad sits.

moment.reader_end: The chapter has just ended. The reader stops — and your ad is the only thing on the screen.
moment.home_carousel: The first screen of the app. Your poster stands among the titles everyone opens.
moment.manga_detail: Seen by a reader who has picked a title and is about to start it.
moment.catalog_grid: In the middle of the catalogue, among the covers a reader is browsing.

calculator.title: Work out the price
calculator.shareHint: {share}% of this placement's daily impressions — about {count} a day.
calculator.minOrderFix: Raise the share or the length.

form.description: The price comes from the rate card — no manual amount.
form.name: Ad name
form.frequencyCapHint: Doesn't change the price — you pay for the number of impressions. This only spreads them out: lower means more different people see the ad, higher means each person sees it more often.
